headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty struggled as global tensions and weak returns pushed indices toward critical support levels.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Geopolitical tensions escalated following US travel warnings for 10 nations due to Saudi-Houthi conflict.
Nifty reached a critical inflection point after two years of relatively weak returns according to JioBlackRock.
Fading enthusiasm in the primary market as NSE GMP fell to its lowest level since the IPO announcement.
Concerns over an AI-driven hiring freeze in the tech sector impacting global headcount and sentiment.
whatHappening: Investors are closely monitoring GIFT Nifty, Nikkei, and Kospi for opening cues for the upcoming week.
Paytm remains under heavy scrutiny as analysts debate whether the stock market will face another crash.
A massive $1.5 trillion wealth transfer is prompting Indian HNIs to aggressively rebuild family portfolios.
Market participants are focusing on FII flows and crude oil prices as Nifty seeks support near 21 September.
summary: The Indian market ended the last session on a cautious note as global geopolitical risks and weak historical returns weighed on investor confidence. While the market is closed for the weekend, focus has shifted to upcoming support levels and the impact of FII activity. Tech stocks face additional pressure from reports of slowing AI adoption and hiring freezes across major nations.
